[NLFC.4.2] Coordinating across engines is the integrator's concern. There is no
built-in pub/sub, fact replication, or shared state. To propagate facts between
engines, subscribe to the source engine's stream (gate on `DS_EV_ACTION_PUBLISH`),
encode the fact, and `ds_engine_assert` it on the destination ([NCBK.10]).
